Third-party licences

LIGHTS OUT's own code and content are proprietary (all rights reserved). The game includes the third-party software, font and data below; each keeps its own licence, and nothing in the game's licence or terms limits your rights under them. See also the terms of use.

Software and fonts

  • Titillium Web font (@fontsource/titillium-web) 5.3.0 - OFL-1.1
    Game: font files
  • Stripe Node.js library (stripe) 22.6.2 - MIT
    Online server only: card payments for paid sponsors; not sent to players
  • three.js 0.186.1 - MIT
    Game: 3D engine, bundled into the game script
  • Vite 8.3.5 - MIT
    Game: small runtime helpers the build tool adds to the game script
  • ws 8.22.0 - MIT
    Online race server only; not sent to players

Data

  • Circuit layouts: bacinger/f1-circuits - MIT
    Game: circuit centre lines (resampled, smoothed and given elevation by the game)
  • Elevation data: NASA SRTM v3 (SRTMGL3, 90 m) via OpenTopoData - Public domain
    Game: circuit elevation profiles
